style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: The most magical time of the year just got even more special. This frosted Christmas tree from HOMCOM is a wonderful way to enjoy the season with your family. It’s covered with faux snow on all the tips to create your own winter wonderland. Formed of full and realistic tips, the plastic structure is strong enough to hold decorations and tinsel. With little mess, simple assembly and the opportunity to create your own impeccable ambience, this tree will make the season more magical than ever. White-painted ends for a snow-dipped look. Plenty of branches for a full and realistic look. Metal base included to keep the tree standing steady. Tall top branch for a star or angel. Comes in easy-to-fix-together pieces for simple assembly and storage. It is recommended to spend 25–30 minutes fluffing the branches once the pieces are fixed together. Colour: Green. Materials: PVC, Metal. Overall dimensions: 5.5FT: F48 x 165Hcm. 6FT: F53 x 190Hcm. 7.5FT: F56 x 225Hcm. Tip count: 5.5FT: 443. 6FT: 570. 7.5FT: 624. Note: For indoor use only, not for outdoor use. Only the tree with the stand is included. Ornaments are not included and are used for display purposes only.
